title: University Goce Delcev At Stip
description: ugd.edu.mk Goce Delcev University in Stip, North Macedonia, is a state university founded in 27 March 2007 and named after the revolutionary Goce Delchev, now the second ranked university in the country. Led by rector Dejan Mirakovski, it unites 12 faculties and 3 art academies plus the associated Military Academy General Mihailo Apostolski across 4 campuses in Stip. Around 7000 students study over 70 programs from medicine and law to IT and film, with the Medical Sciences Faculty alone hosting half of all students and 600 plus international enrollees. Its strength is digitalisation, e-index, e-learning, an e-library with over 1000 titles and distance learning, plus a new UGD Startup Center. The university leads the e-Campus work package of the ACE2-EU European University Alliance, nine universities in nine countries, and holds 400 plus Erasmus agreements, the most of any Macedonian university. Roots go deeper than 2007, the Education Faculty traces back to a teachers school of 1946.
